description: Message the bot in Feishu and DotCraft replies in the same chat.

interface.shortDescription: Send and receive messages via a custom app bot.
interface.longDescription: Message the bot in Feishu and DotCraft replies in the same chat. In groups, mention the bot. Replies can include formatted text, images, and files, and approvals appear as cards.
interface.defaultPrompt: Summarize this Feishu thread and save the next action to workspace memory.
